title: Lear 31A — low-time light jet reel
hook: Low time is a light jet's best-kept secret.
body:
This 2001 Learjet 31A carries just 5,923 hours on the airframe — genuinely low time for the type — and the maintenance to match: a fresh Phase A–D, the 12-year complete, and engines enrolled on MSP Gold.

The 31A still climbs like a rocket and cruises with airplanes that cost far more to feed. When the logbook is this clean, the airplane makes its own case.

Full spec and status reports on request.
